name: garmin-pp-mcp
description: Your whole Garmin history in a local database, not one 28-day page at a time.

garmin_access_token.title: GARMIN_ACCESS_TOKEN
garmin_access_token.description: Optional. Sets GARMIN_ACCESS_TOKEN for the Garmin Connect MCP server. Get a credential from https://sso.garmin.com/portal/sso/en-US/sign-in.

garmin_base_url.title: GARMIN_BASE_URL
garmin_base_url.description: Optional. Sets GARMIN_BASE_URL for the Garmin Connect MCP server. Per-instance, non-secret setting; not a credential.

garmin_token.title: GARMIN_TOKEN
garmin_token.description: Optional. Sets GARMIN_TOKEN for the Garmin Connect MCP server. Get a credential from https://sso.garmin.com/portal/sso/en-US/sign-in.

garmin_user_agent.title: GARMIN_USER_AGENT
garmin_user_agent.description: Optional. Sets GARMIN_USER_AGENT for the Garmin Connect MCP server. Per-instance, non-secret setting; not a credential.
